movelist.name: Poison Jab
movelist.effect: Poison Jab Poisons the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Dark Pulse
movelist.effect: Dark Pulse Flinches the target on 17+

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Barb Barrage
movelist.effect: The target is Poisoned on a 17+. Once a Scene, if Barb Barrage’s target has a Status Condition, you may choose to not roll for Five Strike. Instead, treat Barb Barrage as though it automatically rolled an 8 for Five Strike.

movelist.name: Spikes
movelist.effect: Set 8 square meters of Spikes within your range, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Spikes. Spikes cause terrain to count as Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazards will lose a Tick of Hit Points and become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage. You may target a specific foe only once per Scene with Intimidate.
